newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
ARGENTINA, Jan 21 - Santa Fe - No vessels berthed, none in roads, 1 vessel due to load wheat. Max. recommended draft 29 ft.

10 ins. at access channel. Diamante - No vessels berthed, none in roads, none due. Max. recommended draft 29 ft. 10 ins. at passage km 520. San Lorenzo - Five vessels berthed, all loading, of which 1 pellets, 2 vegetable oil, 2 sbm. 6 Vessels in roads, 23 due at 9 terminals during this week and next. Max.

recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Pasa berth draft 24 ft. 8 ins. Fw. Rosario - Four vessels berthed of which 2 awaiting orders, 1 loading maize, 1 loading sbmp. 2 Vessels in roads, 10 due within this week and next. Max. recommended draft guided by E
Villa Constitucion - No vessels berthed, none in roads, 2 due. Elevator berths - Max. draft 22 ft. 0 ins. Fw. Max.

recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. San Nicolas - One vessel berthed discharging ore, no vessels in roads, 7 due within the next week. Max. recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. San Ppedro - One vessel berthed discharging fertiliser, 2 in roads, none due. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mmitre channel. Drafts for Emilio Mitre channel as follows, vessels up to 22 metres beam 3,200 ft/fw (high tide), vessels over 22 metres beam 3,106 ft/fw (high tide).

Buenos Aires - 12 Vessels in port, 19 due within the next week. Max. recommended draft 31 ft. 6 ins. Fw high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Dock sud max. recommended draft 29 ft. Fw. high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Necochea - Five vessels berthed of which 3 loading wheat, 1 fresh fish. 5 Vessels in roads, 7 due within the next week. Depth at zero at the access channel, 37 ft. 4 ins. Bw. Max. recommended sailing draft high tide 40 ft. 0 ins. Bw., with special permission from the Coast Guard. Bahia Blanca - Five vessels berthed of which 2 loading wheat, 1 soya pellets, 1 sun oil, 1 awaiting orders. No vessels in roads, 19 due within the next week.

BRAZIL, Jan 24 - Vitoria - Five vessels berthed of which 1 bulk malt discharger, 1 cotton discharger, 1 silicon iron loader, 1 steel products loader, 1 cellulose/paper loader. Tubarao - 3 Iron ore loaders, 1 petroleum discharger. Praia Mole - 2 Steel products loaders, 2 bulk coal dihargers. Portocel - 2 Cellulose loaders. Ubu - No vessels, 10 waiting in roads. Rio de Janeiro - 11 vessels berthed of which 4 general cargo dischargers, 1 wheat discharger, 1 bulker discharger, 1 paper discharger, 2 steel products dischargers, 2 sugar loaders. Tecon - No vessels, 25 due over the next 7 days.

Santos - 27 Vessels berthed of which 1 bulk oil discharger, 2 bulk chemical products dischargers, 5 full containers, 2 general cargo, 6 general cargo/container loaders/dischargers, 2 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 1 bulk cement discharger, 2 bagged sugar loaders, 3 bulk wheat dischargers, 2 juice loaders, 1 sulphur discharger. 7 vessels waiting in roads/ 66 vessels due over the next 7 days. Private terminals - Cosipa - 1 Iron ore discharger, 2 steel products loaders, 1 bulk coal discharger. Ultrafertil - 1 Bulk fertiliser discharger. Sao Sebastiao -

Tebar - 3 Vessels berthed. Commercial quay - 1 Vessel berthed, 1 waiting in roads, 7 due over the next 7 days. Paranagua - Ten vessels berthed of which 2 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 1 general cargo discharger, 1 container discharger, 2 reefer loaders, 3 pellets loaders, 1 general cargo loader. 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 1 general cargo vessel to load, 4 container vessels to discharge. 22 Vessels due over the next 7 days. Rio Grande - Four vessels berthed of which 2 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 2 full container loaders. 2 Vessels waiting in roads, 16 due over the next 10 days.

CHILE, Jan 20 - Arica - two vessels berthed and operating, 3 berths vacant, 8 vessels due during the week. Iquique - four vessels berthed and operating, 1 berth vacant, 7 vessels due during the week. Antofagasta - six vessels berthed, 1 berth vacant, 10 vessels due during the week to load/discharge concentrates, bulk copper, containers and general cargo, 1 vessel in roads awaiting cargo.

Valparaiso - five vessels berthed and operating, 2 berths vacant, 1 berth pier 3) out of service until April for enlargement, 17 vessels due during the week. San Antonio - six vessels operating, 3 berths vacant, 16 vessels due during the week, port busy but no waiting time. Puerto Montt - two coasters berthed, no vessels waiting in roads, 5 vessels due during the week. Punta Arenas - three vessels, 1 coaster berthed, 6 vessels due during the week.

Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - one vessel berthed and operating, 2 vessels due this week, no vessels waiting in roads. San Vicente - three vessels berthed and operating, no vessels waiting in roads, 7 vessels due this week. Navy pier (Molo 500) - 1 vessel berthed at terminal, 2 vessels due during the week. Steel pier - 1 vessel berthed at terminal. Coronel pier - no vessels at terminal. Oil terminal - no vessels berthed, none due. Lirquen - two vessels berthed, 4 berths vacant, 5 vessels due during the week. Penco - no vessels at terminal.

PERU , Jan 20 - no strikes at any port. Callao - four vessels anchored/ 4 general cargo/container vessels berthed/ no berthing delays. Paita - no vessels anchored/ 1 fish meal vessel berthed/ no berthing delays. Bayovar, pisco - no vessels, no delays. Talara - no vessels anchored/ 1 oil tanker berthed/ no berthing delays. Chimbot - two vessels anchored/ 1 fish meal vessel berthed/ no berthing delays. Ilo - no vessels anchored/ 1 vehicle vessel berthed/ no berthing delays.

VENEZUELA, Jan 21 - All ports working normally. Orinoco river - Draft 21/1, 30 ft. 6 ins. Puerto Ordaz - Two vessels operating of which 1 loading iron ore, 1 discharging bulk cargo, 3 vessels due. Boca Grande - One vessel due. Mile 178 - Two vessels waiting at anchorage to load. Matanzas - Six vessels operating of which 4 loading steel products, 2 loading general cargo, 3 vessels due. San Felix - One vessel loading steel products. Venalum - Three vessels operating of which 1 loading aluminium, 1 vessel due. Alcasa - One vessel discharging coke, 1 vessel due. Interalumina - One vessel due. Punta Cuchillo - One vessel due. Puerto Cabello - Ten vessels loading/discharging general cargo, 21

La Guaira - Three vessels loading/discharging general cargo, 4 vessels due, 2 vessels under repair. Maracaibo - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load/discharge. 4 Vessels loading/discharging general cargo. Puerto Miranda - Three vessels loading crude oil. El Tablazo - One vessel loading urea. Buoy b. 71 - One vessel loading coal. La Salina - Two vessels loading crude oil. Punta Camacho - One vessel loading crude oil. San Francisco, Palmarejo Sur, Punta Palma, San Lorenzo, Bajo Grande, La Ceiba - No vessels. Cardon - Six vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 5 vessels loading refined products. Amuay - One vessel loading refined products.
